body: Finally someone explains the pepper thing! My grandmother's rasam always tasted different from the Tamil versions and I never knew why.
Tried this with the KokoFresh powder last night. Ten minutes, no fuss. The jaggery tip at the end is the real secret.
Is it okay to keep them in the fridge door? Bangalore humidity is brutal in monsoon.
The off-the-heat tip fixed years of bitter rasam. I always tipped the powder straight into hot ghee and wondered why it tasted burnt.
